parts.text: Chlorine reacts with carbon monoxide to produce phosgene gas, COC l 2 (g). A catalyst is used. C l 2 (g) + CO(g) COC l 2 (g) The reaction is exothermic.

ms.label: 4(a)
ms.text:
M1 E of making bonds > breaking bonds
M2 bond making releases energy
M3 bond breaking requires energy
